# Cross-language vector for gc_sim::input_frame::InputSample's quantization
# and bit-packing rules, generated by this file. See its module doc for
# the generation command and rationale.
#
# Format: one field per non-comment, non-blank line, tab-separated:
#   field_name<TAB>value
# Cases are separated by a blank line, each opened by a `case` line.
# `held_actions`/`edge_actions` are comma-joined canonical action names
# (empty when none); `move_x`/`move_y`/`held`/`edges` are the expected
# InputSample fields `gc_sim::input_frame::new_sample` produced from
# quantizing raw_move_x/raw_move_y and packing held_actions/edge_actions'
# bits. raw_move_x/raw_move_y use Rust's default f64 Display (shortest
# round-trippable decimal) rather than %.17g -- simpler to generate
# correctly and an equal-or-stronger round-trip guarantee: every value
# here parses back to the identical f64 bit pattern via both Rust's
# f64::from_str and JavaScript's Number(). move_x/move_y/held/edges are
# plain integers (every one of them is i64 here).
